title: MZ Screenzoom Plugin is making my event sprite s blurry

posts.author: reigunz
posts.body:
No matter what I set the zoom to, my sprites will be blurry, and have black bars looping to the opposite end of the sprite if pixels are touching the sprite border (Like if my Sprite's feet are touching the bottom of the box, there'll be black lines at the top of the sprite where the feet are touching the bottom).
I only have 2 plugins installed: ODUE Battlebacks, and the Screenzoom plugin. Using the screenzoom alone doesn't change anything, so it's not ODUE Battleback interfering.
I have my sprite size set 16x16 and my tiles set the same. The thing is, the tiles don't appear blurry, only events do.
(The trees are tiles, but the rest are events)

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
reigunz said:
have black bars looping to the opposite end of the sprite if pixels are touching the sprite border
Click to expand...
That's because they are. Check if your spritesheets are actually aligned correctly.
For the blur, I believe RPG Maker does have a sort of anti aliasing, so a pixel perfect plugin like this one should probably do the trick:
https://galenmereth.itch.io/pixel-perfect-for-rpg-maker

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
Some zoom plugins due to the algorithm they use also will cause the last pixel of the bottom to be the top line, and vice versa. To fix that you need the top and bottom row of the sprite to be empty. Nothing.
The one I use even has that in the documentation and warn its an artifact of using non-integer zooms.
